subject: Zephyr Bank SIG & Evidence: mapping, delivery plan, and legal clarifications
messages:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@zephyrbank.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 15:14:00 +0100
Subject: Request: SIG completion and evidence bundle for procurement review

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the intro call last week. Attached is the SIG template we ask all vendors to complete (Zephyr_SIG_v2.xlsx). For evaluation we need: a completed SIG, a prioritized mapping of controls to evidence (what you'll provide vs. what we should validate in the product), and copies of your latest SOC 2 and ISO certificates where available.

Deadline: May 6 EOD (internal panel scheduled May 10).

Two short clarifications for procurement/legal: 1) we need an explicit list of subprocessors and 2) confirmation of data residency for EU customer workloads. If you can flag any known gaps now we can scope follow-up items.

Please send an initial plan for delivery and an estimate of effort by tomorrow EOD (we know this is fast).

Best,
Ioana Munteanu
Vendor Ops | Zephyr Bank
Attachments: Zephyr_SIG_v2.xlsx
From: dylan.brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: SIG completion and evidence bundle for procurement review

Team — forwarding Zephyr's SIG + asks. Deadline is tight (May 6). Can each of you own the following and respond with what we can deliver by May 4 so I can assemble a package?

- Neha: lead control mapping and SOC 2 narrative + call out any evidence gaps (retention, logging, etc.)
- Soojin: collect technical artifacts (network diagrams, key rotation, backup procedures) and confirm where evidence lives.
- Aditya: confirm audit artifacts and estimated time to pull raw logs for the requested retention window; also flag any legal/subprocessor concerns.

I'll draft the external plan and upload a mutual-action-plan. Mention any blockers (legal redlines, third-party delays).

Dylan
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SIG completion and evidence bundle for procurement review

Thanks — quick read through and initial plan below. Attachment: redwood_retention-summary.pdf (short artifact).

High level (will provide a detailed control->artifact table by May 4):
- SOC 2 narrative: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report for the last 12 months (report dated 2026-11) and a control narrative mapping to SIG sections A–F.
- ISO 27001: we have an ISO 27001:2019 certificate issued 2025 (can include scope document).
- Evidence prioritization: recommend we deliver the following first: SOC 2 report + control narrative, subprocessor roster, data residency statement, and key architecture diagrams. Follow-up artifacts (audit logs, specific config screenshots) can be staged on the secure upload for Zephyr to pull.

Open questions / blockers for legal:
1) Retention: Zephyr's RFP references a 7-year retention window for some evidence. We need to confirm which evidence types they require for 7 years vs. our standard 2 year log retention.
2) Subprocessors: we have a standard subprocessors list but legal may want SLA-level commitments — advise if Zephyr expects contract-level amendments.

I will draft the control mapping spreadsheet and flag gaps.

– Neha
Sr. Security PM, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_retention-summary.pdf
From: soojin.lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: dylan.brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, neha.kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SIG completion and evidence bundle for procurement review

Notes from infra/ops re: evidence availability: 
- SOC 2 artifacts: AWS account-level config exports, key rotation logs (KMS), and backup runbooks exist. We can produce sanitized screenshots and exported config files.
- Data residency: we can confirm EU-only processing if the customer pins a region; hosted API defaults to multi-region for latency, but we support EU-only projects on Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Evidence locations: most artifacts live in our secure Drive folder (link to be provided) and access requires the secure upload flow. For immediate deliverables we can pull: redwood_soc2_report_2026.pdf, architecture-diagram-v2.png, kms-rotation-matrix.csv (sanitized).

I'll assemble a zip of the high-priority artifacts and aim to hand off to Dylan by May 3. If legal requests raw logs beyond our standard retention window we'll need a scoped request (time + reason).

— Soojin
Senior Cloud Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: dylan.brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@zephyrbank.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, soojin.lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG completion and evidence bundle for procurement review

Ioana — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Below is our proposed delivery plan (high-level):

1) By May 3: Deliverable package — SOC 2 report (pdf), ISO scope statement, subprocessor roster, and an initial control->evidence mapping (spreadsheet).
2) By May 6: Complete SIG template (Zephyr_SIG_v2.xlsx) and prioritized artifact bundle uploaded to secure-upload link.
3) Post-review: address any clarifications within 48 hours during your evaluation week.

We have one legal clarification before formal delivery: for EU customer workloads, Redwood can guarantee EU-only data residency for Dedicated and Private deployments. For our hosted multi-tenant API we route data through regional endpoints but cannot offer contractual guarantees of EU-only processing unless a Dedicated/Private deployment is selected. Can you confirm which deployment model Zephyr is considering for this procurement?

Also please confirm acceptance of delivery via our secure-upload endpoint (link below). For the SOC 2 report we will deliver the full report (redwood_soc2_report_2026.pdf) and a sanitized control evidence packet for procurement review.

Secure upload: https://secure-upload.redwood.com/zephyr/upload/abc123
Drive (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AJ.../Zephyr-RFP-evidence

I attached a short mutual action plan to this thread (mutual-action-plan-zephyr.pdf) outlining responsibilities and dates. If this approach works I'll start assembling the artifacts and have the control mapping spreadsheet by May 4.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that speeds things up.

Dylan
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual-action-plan-zephyr.pdf
From: Ioana Munteanu <ioana.m@zephyrbank.com>
To: dylan.brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@zephyrbank.com>
Cc: Legal - Zephyr <legal@zephyrbank.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 17:42:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Request: SIG completion and evidence bundle for procurement review

Dylan — thanks for the fast turnaround and clear plan. Zephyr's preference is EU-only processing; procurement panel will prioritize vendors who can guarantee that for the production environment. For evaluation we are fine with hosted vendors who can demonstrate a migration plan to EU-only Dedicated/Private in contract.

We accept the secure upload link you provided for artifact delivery. Please provide the SOC 2 report and the subprocessor roster first.

One legal note: our counsel asked whether Redwood requires subprocessors that perform core inference (model-hosting partners). If so, please disclose names and whether they have access to plaintext customer data.

Attached: zephyr_signed_mou.pdf (acknowledgement of receipt).

Regards,
Ioana
Vendor Ops | Zephyr Bank
Attachments: zephyr_signed_mou.pdf
